Diffs (max channel > 8): r40 vs r41 for q15 and q16, r40n vs r41 for q17, and s40 vs s41. The script reproduces every w40a r40 number. Script and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/799b632d-abc8-5982-a611-3a2c97f75011/scratchpad/raterA41 (m.py, q17.py, belt.py; q15.png / q16.png / q17.png = render over photo; c_e*.png = s40 | s41).
calibrationNote: The score held at 8.3; the detail mean is 8.24 (w40 8.21). Gains: the far rows (+0.4: the darker covers now give the far rows their dark row gaps) and the pouch (+0.2). Loss: the cover (-0.1). It now matches q15 but is 10 L darker in q16, and at grazing in q17 it reads as a narrow, neutral band. The q17 camera move itself was not scored; only the new-frame measurements were. The r40n -> r41 q17 diff is only 0.9 % (pans and pouches at y > 500), so the new-frame q17 findings (narrow cover, no teal webbing) were already present at w40.

issues.title: q17: the headrest wing hides half the cover, which reads as a narrow white band
issues.evidence: On the new q17 frame the near headrest shows 29-48 cover px per row at y 110-180, vs 66-88 per row at y 210-260 in y_47303 (about 0.5x). In the render a large raised fleck wing (735-790, 110-180; L71, B/R 2.10) sits in front of the cover. In the photo the cover lies proud over the headrest face, wraps past the near edge, and only a short wing bulge shows beside it. In s41 e4_head the wings stand forward of the cover on both sides.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js cover lofts (lines ~134 / 139): bring the cover forward about 1.5 cm (z offset -0.1149..-0.0985 -> about -0.13..-0.115) and widen it 0.22 -> 0.24 so it laps over the wing fronts. Alternatively, pull the wing pads back 1.5 cm and cut their forward bulge by 40 %. Check: q17 near-headrest cover px per row >= 55 at y 120-170, and q15 cover E/F boxes within 5 L of 65 / 44.
